text: OVERDOSAGE Overdosage may occur. The adverse effects of overdosage are life-threatening and affect mainly the pulmonary and cardiovascular system. The symptoms may include cyanosis, bradycardia, acidosis, pulmonary hemorrhage, convulsions, coma and cardiac arrest. Treatment of an overdose is directed toward the support of all vital functions and prompt institution of symptomatic therapy. Diatrizoate salts are dialyzable. The intravenous LD 50 value of diatrizoate meglumine and diatrizoate sodium (in grams of iodine/kilogram body weight) varied from 5.3 to 6.1 g/kg in mice. The LD 50 values decrease as the rate of injection increases.
